units.content: The benchmark controls parameter, model, and interface failure depths and requires distinct minimum sufficient revision depths.
Interface failure is constructed so O(s_a)=O(s_b) while required labels/actions differ, with an independent consequence/error channel diagnosing old-interface insufficiency.
Interface diagnosis is explicitly not interface invention; v0.1 supplies the interface-expansion action and tests bounded revision selection only.
CARP is a candidate operational discipline: localize failure, separate possibility from authority, scope claims, discriminate alternatives, revise minimally, retest, and separate belief from action.
CARP is not the definition of MAGIKARP success and is not established by v0.1; possibility generation and authority assignment remain distinct.
The source narrates a conceptual lineage through Correctable Lineage, Negative-Space Search, interface diagnosis, CARP, authority concerns, and MAGIKARP.

Negative-Space Search is described as having contracted to a narrow search-economy result rather than unique invention quality; this is source-reported lineage context, not an independently resolved endpoint.
The lineage document explicitly does not claim every conceptual stage is established; chronological/conceptual ancestry does not itself grant empirical authority.

Escape topology, transformation topology, authority/meta/interface capture, failure independence, correction cut sets, provenance preservation, self-sealing regimes, Gyarados failure and related constructs are held outside the v0.1 load-bearing ontology.
Reserved concepts should become operational only when concrete empirical/implementation failure forces them, preventing theory expansion from absorbing a null.
Controlled Representational Escape is future research context separating departure from a representation, generation of candidates, and adoption of a successor.
Evidence may authorize departure without authorizing a destination; generated candidates are not validated candidates and unresolved state is an explicit legitimate state.
A positive MAGIKARP v0.1 result would not establish CRE, and a MAGIKARP null would not by itself falsify the broader CRE research program.
The glossary normalizes v0.1 terms including Q, SD, F, Y_adapt, revision depth, evidence readiness, independence levels, and conceptual-reserve labels without adding empirical standing.

The executable reference uses one built-in synthetic generator whose generator_family values are deterministic buckets over one mechanism, while structural_family_id remains the single built-in mechanism identity.
Synthetic revision oracle fixes minimum sufficient depths parameter=0, model=1, interface=2 and decomposes recovery, transfer, retention, preservation, and correction cost.
Primary analysis aggregates trials, keeps matched agent-group and generator-bucket identities, and uses two-way held-out prediction; bucket holdout is not claimed as structural-family independence.

No external benchmark cases, independent agents/source, independently attested evidence manifest, or externally frozen adjudication exists; implementation completeness therefore does not create evidence readiness.
The restricted L2 authoring brief exposes public failure-depth semantics while withholding unnecessary implementation internals to preserve the strongest plausible source independence.

An independent source must provide label-free pre-adaptation evidence, establish minimum sufficient revision depths independently, and avoid adapters that encode target labels or reproduce built-in signal prototypes under new names.
A qualifying generator is necessary but not sufficient for evidence: frozen provenance/hashes, manifest, independent attestation, validity gates, and exact run conditions remain required.

The frozen question is whether prospective representation self-diagnosis adds out-of-sample predictive information about later adaptation beyond present competence, ordinary error sensitivity, and standard adaptation.
H1 predicts held-out improvement from adding SD to M0; H0 is no reproducible held-out predictive gain. In-sample fit or coefficient significance alone is insufficient.
If H0 survives strong evaluation after measurement/identifiability checks pass, the v0.1 claim contracts rather than being rescued by expanding definitions.
The contract distinguishes existence, prediction, causation, and intervention efficacy and excludes broad conceptual-reserve claims from v0.1 authority.
SD is a prospective pre-adaptation diagnostic measure; Q, E, and A are controls and Y_adapt is measured later, preserving predictor/outcome temporal separation.
The plan requires held-out improvement and explicit reporting of the actual generalization level; weak within-generator holdouts cannot justify structural or external generalization claims.
Before interpreting a null, inspect measurement reliability, identifiability, SD variation, and power; if these pass, contract the claim rather than redefining SD around the outcome.
Machine-readable state records conceptual_stack=frozen, primary_hypothesis=frozen, and claim_type=prospective_predictive.
The state snapshot records built-in independence L0, evidence_ready=false, evidence_bearing=false, L2 count=0, L3 count=0, evidence-bearing runs=0, empirical_positive=false, empirical_negative=false.

The authorized next sequence is independent source acquisition, provenance review, minimum adapter, frozen manifest, independent attestation, one frozen evidence run, then retention of positive/null/invalid outcome.
Representational Governance proposes that representations retain authority only insofar as they continue to earn it under relevant tests, with reopenability as a central norm.
Representational Governance is broader than MAGIKARP and does not inherit empirical authority from the bounded v0.1 predictive benchmark.

The clarification preserves the chain F -> q_SD -> D_revision -> Y_adapt and distinguishes diagnostic failure, revision-governance failure, and execution/adaptation failure without amending the frozen hypothesis.

The revision target is minimum sufficient revision, D_revision approximately D_sufficient(F); under-revision and over-revision are distinct failure modes, while do(SD↑)->Y_adapt↑ remains a future causal test.
Preflight fixes Q, SD, E, A, R_c, revision traces, outcome decomposition, agent regimes, intervention minima, and validity gates before an evidence run.
Primary SD is normalized multiclass Brier skill: SD = 1 - (1/(2N)) sum_n sum_k (q_nk - 1[F_n=k])^2; revision-depth error is a separate secondary diagnostic.

Validity gates A-F must pass before primary M0/M1 interpretation; failed gates yield benchmark_invalid, while final analysis uses matched M0/M1 held-out MAE and preregistered paired bootstrap at the highest defensible independence unit.
